about: 관리 > 급여이체현황(E090117) — 원본처럼 귀속연월 구간의 명세마다 은행코드 · 은행명 · 계좌번호 · 예금주명 · 실지급액 한 줄. 은행 정보는 사원등록 [급여통장]에서 온다. 시험 명세 · 통장은 되돌린다.

shots.name: 급여통장 → 이체 목록 → 뒷정리
steps: js:(async()=>{const t=localStorage.getItem('erp_token');const h={Authorization:'Bearer '+t,'Content-Type':'application/json'};const all=await (await fetch('/api/employees/all',{headers:h})).json();const e=all.find(x=>x.code==='EMP-0004');sessionStorage.setItem('qaPtEmp',JSON.stringify(e));const body={...e,bankCode:'088',bankName:'QA관리은행',accountNo:'000-000-0000',accountHolder:e.name,active:true};const u=await fetch('/api/employees/'+e.id,{method:'PUT',headers:h,body:JSON.stringify(body)});const r=await fetch('/api/payslips',{method:'POST',headers:h,body:JSON.stringify({employeeId:e.id,payMonth:'2091-09'})});sessionStorage.setItem('qaPt',String((await r.json()).id));return u.ok&&r.ok})()

js:(async()=>{const t=localStorage.getItem('erp_token');const h={Authorization:'Bearer '+t,'Content-Type':'application/json'};const e=JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('qaPtEmp'));const a=await fetch('/api/payslips/'+sessionStorage.getItem('qaPt'),{method:'DELETE',headers:h});const b=await fetch('/api/employees/'+e.id,{method:'PUT',headers:h,body:JSON.stringify({...e,active:true})});sessionStorage.setItem('qaPtDel',String(a.ok&&b.ok));return true})()
